_about: James Aitken Wylie (1808-1890), Free Church of Scotland minister: The History of Protestantism (London, Paris and New York: Cassell, Petter and Galpin, undated, 3 vols, illustrated), from the Waldenses and Wycliffe to the Covenanters. Volume numbers read off each title page. Named james-wylie so other Wylies cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
